{{Quote|Prakith. Foga Brill.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="SoL" />}}
'''Prakith''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] that, thanks to its unstable terrain and its isolation, was a difficult location to conquer by force. The planet was a powerful [[Fifth Deep Core Army|Fifth Army]] fortress world during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and later the [[Constitutional Protectorate of Prakith|personal empire]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]].

==Description==
Early in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] history, Prakith was a volatile, [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world, but was stable enough for Imperial survey teams to explore it during their expeditions into the Deep Core. Prakith's close proximity to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] made it a prime location for a hidden redoubt, and was one of the first Deep Core worlds to be civilized. It had a strong [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] presence.<ref name="byss" />

[[File:WyyrlokApproachesTheKeep.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The surface of Prakith]]

Prakith's major cities (such as [[Prak City]]) were built atop the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] large plateaus, surrounded on all sides by great [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] and crevasses. Since ground travel across such terrain proved difficult, natives often used [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] for transportation. The natives were, under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, a relatively subdued and businesslike population.<ref name="byss" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|I know you went to Prakith. I know you went after Andeddu's holocron. I know you were searching for the secret of eternal life.|[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="DoE" />}}
[[File:AndeLeg.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Darth Andeddu, the Immortal God-King of Prakith]]

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Andeddu]] built a tomb for himself on the planet, hidden inside his [[Andeddu's Keep|keep]], after escaping his enemies by building a false one on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. There, his mummified body lay for thousands of years.<ref name="SWL27" />

Millennia later, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|visited]] the planet following the end of the [[New Sith Wars]] in order to obtain [[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]].<ref name="DoE" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|At last report, Prakith was controlled by the Imperial warlord Foga Brill.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="SoL" />}}
The [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] himself selected Prakith as the [[Citadel Inquisitorius|base of operations]] for the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="byss" />

Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]] was [[Battle of the Resurgence|captured]] by her former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Inquisitor [[Valin Draco]]. She was held deep within the Citadel Inquisitorius on Prakith and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]]. Her allies in the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] later tried to rescue her by attacking the Citadel, but she sacrificed herself during the battle to allow the Rebels to escape.<ref name="SotE" />

The Imperials on Prakith voted to continue the war against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] even after the death of Palpatine, and supported the reborn Emperor during his attempt to retake the galaxy. With the [[Destruction of Byss|destruction]] of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]] became an independent Imperial territory led by [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]], the [[Constitutional Protectorate of Prakith]], who was only nominally under the authority of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Cinzero Gann|Gann]]. The planet was impoverished, living conditions miserable. Brill [[Fortress world/Legends|fortified]] Prakith and isolated his micro-empire, defended by a strong [[Grand Imperial Navy|planetary defense fleet]]. The planet was later involved in many years of attritional [[Citadel Inquisitorius|warfare]] with the New Republic.<ref name="byss" />

Foga Brill's ships ''[[Bloodprice]]'' and ''[[Gorath]]'' were destroyed in the Prakith system by the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]'' in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="SoL" />

In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], Foga Brill was betrayed by a cabal of his officers, who killed him and attempted to broker peace with the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> The Prakith system was then integrated into the New Republic and reconnected with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="byss" />

===Later history===
{{Quote|I ''do'' know some of your secrets. The tomb on Korriban in which this holocron was found was not the ''real'' tomb of Darth Andeddu. That much my research shows me. If it were found&hellip;if Darth Andeddu reawoke&hellip;''"<br />"''Would that make you worthy? Perhaps&mdash;if you survive the journey.|[[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok the Third]] and the gatekeeper of Darth Andeddu's holocron|<ref name="SWL27" />}}
At some point before [[37 ABY]], a [[Malevolence (cult)|group]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cultists]] found Andeddu's Keep and isolated themselves there for generations, drawing upon its powers. By [[137 ABY]], the world was still inhabited, with the keep still being located far from the nearest city, hidden amongst inaccessible terrain.<ref name="SWL27" />

[[File:Leg27-DuelonPrakith.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] battles [[Darth Andeddu]].]]

[[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok the Third]] [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Wyyrlok)|ventured]] to the planet in an attempt to find a cure for his [[Darth Krayt|master's]] illness. He was tricked by the [[Holocron of Heresies|holocron]] of Andeddu, which secretly contained his intellect, and was first ambushed by the cult, then the reanimated Sith Lord himself. After having bested the Sith and buried his remains, Wyyrlok took several of his texts and left the planet.<ref name="SWL27" />
